offersHint: Esports cognitive-combine data over MCP: free cohort stats, paid player & team scouting reports. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.neurorank.app/mcp · Optional headers: x-api-key

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: API key for the paid tools (get_player_report, get_team_report). Omit it to use the free anonymous tool get_cohort_stats. Create a key at https://neurorank.app/account (Billing > API access); requires an active scout or team subscription.

headerDocs.name: x-api-key
headerDocs.description: API key for the paid tools (get_player_report, get_team_report). Omit it to use the free anonymous tool get_cohort_stats. Create a key at https://neurorank.app/account (Billing > API access); requires an active scout or team subscription.

toolsPreview.name: get_cohort_stats
toolsPreview.description: Returns NeuroRank's public, aggregate cognitive-combine statistics across all completed combine runs: total runs, estimated trials, median run age, and measured reliability (split-half; test-retest sample still accruing). Read-only, no authentication, aggregate (non-personal) data only.

toolsPreview.name: get_player_report
toolsPreview.description: PAID. Returns a full cognitive-combine report for one player by NeuroRank profile id (NR-XXXXXX): six dimension scores, archetype, the written report, and coaching notes. Requires an API key (header `x-api-key`) belonging to a user with an active scout or team subscription, and is limited to players who have opted in to scouting. Subject to a monthly quota.

toolsPreview.name: get_team_report
toolsPreview.description: PAID (team tier). Analyses a roster of NeuroRank players and returns a composition report: per-dimension team averages, strengths and weaknesses, per-dimension standouts, score spread, archetype mix, and a written team intelligence summary. Requires an API key (header `x-api-key`) on an active team subscription. Only players who have opted in to scouting are included; at least 2 opted-in, scored players are required. Costs one monthly report pull.
